title: Noor and the Semester
author: Jude Ravensworth
blurb: Jude Nakamura, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
